## `domain:ui` PM seat — claimed and dispatched

Session `session_01KbJQ1y1J12nZxYzFWhP8Q3` · branch `claude/issue-7515-unreferenced-source-gate`

**Comment thread read before ruling: zero comments.**

### Disposition: build the gate, scoped to what the card already measured

The card's suggested shape is right and I am adopting it: walk the import graph from each package's declared entry, **union in specifiers resolved through that package's build-config aliases**, and report source files reached by neither.

⭐ **The alias leg is not optional and is the whole difficulty.** Two of the three unreached files in `packages/components` are **false positives** — `lib/use-sync-external-store-shim.ts` and `lib/use-sync-external-store-with-selector-shim.ts` are reached through `vite.config.ts` alias entries that an import-graph walk cannot see. A gate that skips the alias leg reports exactly those two as dead, and a gate whose first run cries wolf on live files gets disabled. The card hands you both fixtures: **those two pin the alias leg, `ui/toast.tsx` pins a true positive**, so it can be pinned in both directions on day one. Do that.

### Scope: `packages/components` first, and say what the rest would cost

Land the gate covering what you can prove it handles correctly. If extending it repo-wide surfaces alias mechanisms you have not modelled (other build configs, tsconfig `paths`, re-export barrels), **scope it to the packages you have verified and state the remainder as a measured number**, rather than shipping a gate that is wrong on packages you did not check. A gate that covers one package correctly beats one that covers forty with false positives.

If the sweep finds more genuine orphans beyond `ui/toast.tsx`, remove the ones inside `packages/components` and **report the count**; anything outside that package is a separate card.

### Why this is worth a gate rather than one-off deletions

The card names it: **an orphan file is cheap; an orphan file wearing a live name is a trap.** The file objectui#7319 removed carried the same export name as a live engine one package over and evaluated no predicate — name-completion alone could have wired a silently wrong renderer into a **published** package. Two were found by a human reading unrelated code this week; that is the detection mechanism this replaces.

### Clause-② determination: **no**

`scripts/` is not a governed surface in this repo; a new gate moves no schema key, no export, and nothing about what a contract accepts or rejects. Deleting a genuinely unreferenced file removes no reachable export — **prove that per file** (it is unreferenced *and* not in the package's public surface) rather than assuming it. **Make your own determination and state it.**

### Scope fence — parallel work

`packages/plugin-markdown/src/toc.ts` (#7658, running). `packages/types/**` (#7654 `triggerIcon`, dispatching now; PR #7662 open). `scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` and `scripts/github-slug.mjs` (#7644, landed — do not modify). Open unlanded PRs also hold the five `getDataConfig` producers (#7660).

### Evidence bar

Reproduce the card's measurement **before** changing anything: the transitive walk over `packages/components`' 210 non-test sources reaching 207. If your number differs from the card's, that is a finding — report it rather than adjusting to match. Every measurement needs a **lit control** (a control reading zero is a dark instrument — discard and rebuild). State **predicted vs observed in writing before** each ablation leg; report a miss **as a miss**. Prove the gate non-vacuous in **both** directions: it fires on `ui/toast.tsx`, and it stays silent on the two alias-reached shims. Mutations proved on disk by anchored counts **and** `git hash-object` movement; restore via `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH` under an `EXIT INT TERM` trap, verified by empty `git diff HEAD` **and** blob equality. ⚠️ A leg that aborts before installing its trap does **not** restore — isolate legs, restore between every one. Exit codes by **redirect before any pipe**; quote each gate's own verdict line. `PRECONDITION NOT MET` is **NOT MEASURED**.

### Standing discipline

Worktree-first (`git worktree add --no-track ../objectui-7515 -b claude/issue-7515-unreferenced-source-gate origin/main`; hook-enforced). **NEVER `git stash`** — the stack is shared across worktrees. vitest from the **repo root**. Heavy runs via `/home/user/objectstack/scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, slot `issue-7515`. Changeset if a released package's source changed. Every base sha is **stale on arrival**.

## PM review — accepted, `Clause-②: no` confirmed. Landing once CI converges.

Determination reached independently: `scripts/` is not governed here, the gate moves no schema key and no export, and **the deletion removes nothing reachable — proved per file, not assumed**, which is the part I asked for explicitly.

### The card's measurement was reconciled, not adjusted

The card measured 210 sources reaching 207 on `746f6f818`; this branch measures **209 / 206** on `f7cf7e8a`. The delta is explained rather than tuned away: `7bf244be` deleted `ui/chart.tsx` on 2026-09-04, *after* the card was written. 210−1=209, 207−1=206, and the **same three** unreached files remain, with two independent walkers agreeing on the population.

I asked for exactly this — *"if your number differs from the card's, that is a finding; report it rather than adjusting to match"* — and it is the difference between a measurement and a number that was made to agree. The framing correction rides along: "42 `check:*` scripts" is 42 **files**, of which 35 are wired as root npm scripts.

### ⭐ Leg 0's miss caught the GATE's own bug, not the tree's

Predicted 1 finding, observed **2** — and the extra one was not a discovery, it was the instrument lying. `auditAliasMechanisms` stored the alias `find` as raw source text and read it with `JSON.parse`, which cannot parse a single-quoted TypeScript string, so it falsely reported `packages/components`' own `@` alias as unmodelled.

Recognising a surplus finding as an **instrument defect** rather than banking it as a result is the whole discipline. Fixed by making `find` a structured value, and the test now pins that exact case so it cannot come back.

### Causation pinned in both directions

- **Leg 1** — drop the three `use-sync-external-store` aliases → predicted 3, observed 3 (both shims plus toast), reached 208 → 206, alias targets 3 → 0. So the gate's **silence on the shims is caused by the alias leg**, not by luck. ⭐ And that mutated run **reproduces the card's import-graph-only figure exactly**, which retroactively confirms the card measured what it said it measured.
- **Leg 2** — add `export * from './toast'` → predicted 0 findings, observed 0 with 209/209 reached. So the toast finding **tracks reachability, not a hard-coded name**.

A gate proved to fire *and* proved to fall silent for the right reason is a gate that can be trusted on day one. That was the ask, and it was met.

### A dark instrument caught mid-flight

The first type-surface reading grepped `dist/index.d.ts` and read 0 — **but its control also read 0**. Discarded and rebuilt against the barrel that actually carries `ui/*`. That is the third dark instrument this seat's dispatches have caught and discarded today rather than published.

### The governance question, read carefully rather than around

AGENTS.md commandment 7 forbids **modifying** Shadcn-synced primitives, because the sync overwrites such edits. You argued that **deletion is not that act** — `getLocalComponents()` derives its tracked set from `readdir(COMPONENTS_DIR)` — and cited `7bf244be` deleting `ui/chart.tsx` from the same zone a day earlier. Neither ignoring the rule nor being blocked by it; reading what it is actually for.

### Design choices I want on the record

- **An alias replacement that is a FILE is a root; one that is a DIRECTORY is a resolution rule — and the filesystem decides which, not the spelling.** That distinction is what makes the alias leg correct rather than heuristic.
- **An alias expression the reader cannot evaluate is a FINDING, never a skip.** Right, and for the stated reason: skipping one would make the gate accuse whatever file that alias points at. A gate that quietly widens its own blind spot is worse than one that fails loudly.
- **Scope is declared in `COVERED_PACKAGES` and the uncovered remainder is printed as a count derived from the workspace every run** (currently 40 packages with a `src/` tree), so the scope statement **cannot rot**. That is better than the "state the remainder as a number" I asked for — a number in a PR body goes stale; a number the gate recomputes does not.

### The orphan cost more than its bytes

Deleting `ui/toast.tsx` also removed `@radix-ui/react-toast`, of which that file was **the only importer anywhere in the repo**, and the published `dist/` loses exactly one file (212 → 211) — which is why a changeset is owed and was added. An orphan file is not just dead code; it drags a dependency into the published tarball.

### Instrument handling

Two `PRECONDITION NOT MET` results recorded and satisfied, plus **two of your own invocations that named unwired script aliases** (`pnpm check:lint-coverage`, `pnpm check:doc-links`, both exit 254) caught as NOT MEASURED and re-run correctly as `node scripts/…`. Catching your own invocation error rather than recording exit 254 as a result is the same reflex as the dark-control catch.

### Follow-up filed

**#7671** — your triage note is now a card: **#6893** (reds on a fully-built tree) and **#7460** (reds on a half-built tree) have **opposite build-state requirements**, so there is no local state in which `scripts/__tests__/` is fully green. You measured it both ways and handed it up as a PM call instead of filing across two existing cards; that was the right escalation, and the conjunction — which neither existing card records — is what actually bites a contributor.

## Landed

PR #7670 merged at 2026-09-04T17:24 through the merge queue. Verified `merged: true` before closing. Closing; `pm:dispatched` stripped.

`check:unreferenced-sources` is now wired into `ci.yml`. A `.tsx` that nothing reaches can no longer sit in a published package indefinitely — both instances found this week (objectui#7319, objectui#7397) were found by a human reading unrelated code.

### The measurement was reconciled, not adjusted

209 / 206 on this base against the card's 210 / 207, with the delta explained by `7bf244be` deleting `ui/chart.tsx` after the card was written — and the **same three** unreached files remaining, confirmed by two independent walkers. That is the difference between a measurement and a number made to agree.

### The first ablation leg caught the GATE's own bug

Predicted 1 finding, observed 2 — and the surplus was the instrument lying, not a discovery: `auditAliasMechanisms` stored the alias `find` as raw source text and read it with `JSON.parse`, which cannot parse a single-quoted TypeScript string, so it falsely accused `packages/components`' own `@` alias. Recognising a surplus finding as an **instrument defect** rather than banking it is the whole discipline. Fixed, and the test pins that case.

Then causation was pinned both ways: dropping the three aliases produced exactly 3 findings and reproduced the card's import-graph-only figure, so the silence on the shims is **caused by** the alias leg; adding `export * from './toast'` produced 0, so the toast finding **tracks reachability, not a hard-coded name**.

### Design decisions worth carrying forward

- **An alias replacement that is a FILE is a root; a DIRECTORY is a resolution rule — the filesystem decides, not the spelling.**
- **An unevaluable alias expression is a FINDING, never a skip** — skipping would make the gate accuse whatever that alias points at. A gate that quietly widens its own blind spot is worse than one that fails loudly.
- **Scope is declared in `COVERED_PACKAGES`, and the uncovered remainder is recomputed from the workspace every run** (currently 40 packages with a `src/` tree). Better than the static number I asked for: a count in a PR body goes stale, one the gate recomputes cannot.

### The orphan cost more than its bytes

Deleting `ui/toast.tsx` also removed `@radix-ui/react-toast`, of which it was **the only importer anywhere in the repo**, and the published `dist/` lost exactly one file. Note the bundle report was **unchanged at 510.70KB** — which is the point: an unreferenced file contributes nothing to the bundle while still shipping in the tarball, so no bundle-size gate could ever have found it.

### Follow-up

**#7671** — your triage note, now a card: **#6893** (reds on a fully-built tree) and **#7460** (reds on a half-built tree) have **opposite build-state requirements**, so there is no local state in which `scripts/__tests__/` is fully green. Measured both ways, and correctly handed up as a PM call rather than filed across two existing cards.
